t0023-01.gloss: A dispatch log records an acknowledgment from a receiver held for repair during an evacuation alert.
t0023-01.rival_reading: A field monitor could have been under repair during a test transmission, and a charged battery does not prove it was tuned to the right channel.

cites.quote: Over 20 years experience in electronic repair and maintenance.

t0023-02.gloss: A field-trial radio failure and its unpaid repair are recorded together.
